items.item_text: Requires a master’s degree in a social science, mathematics, statistics, business, economics, research, or other related field, or the equivalent and two years of experience conducting research, analyzing data, and presenting findings. Understanding of and sensitivity to meeting the needs of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability and ethnic background of the student, community, and employee population.
Minimum Qualifications for Education and Experience
Management experience in institutional research, planning, or institutional effectiveness in a higher education setting, preferably a community college.
Experience supervising, leading, or coordinating professional research or data-analysis staff and managing multiple research priorities and deliverables.
Experience with state and federal higher education reporting requirements, such as IPEDS and California Community Colleges Chancellor’s Office reporting.
Experience developing or using data warehouses, dashboards, business intelligence tools, or other self-service reporting systems.
Experience supporting institutional planning, program review, accreditation, or institutional effectiveness processes through research and data analysis.
Experience with data governance and data integrity, including data validation, documentation, and consistent institutional reporting.
